title: Check the caller contract and owner lifetime before repairing a helper
applies_when: A validation, descriptor/global, identity/cache, field-loss or cleanup claim omits its callee, caller, owner or result assembly.
lesson: Read the callee and real invocation before dependencies: validation may live inside the callee. Trace descriptors, globals, platform predicates, retained references, outer cleanup and ordered spreads. SDK cancellation may leave outer retries alive; abort failed uploads without cancelling callers or closing successful streams. Admission exceptions may allow cleanup before final validation. Test supported entries with normal controls. Missing invented APIs are feature deltas; check maintainer decisions. Use counterexamples to select evidence, not blanket rejection.
avoid_when: Public helper defects need no internal caller. Retained references do not prevent mutation/concurrency bugs. Cleanup tests cover only reached paths; spreads only then-present properties. Never close caller-owned successful streams. Source examples are revision-bound, not general accuracy or hardware qualification.

evidence.note: parseLocalDate validates exact length/calendar ranges internally and returns no rest slice. Missing caller rest checks are not trailing-input acceptance. Acquire the callee; source evidence only.
Maintainer held BinaryUnmarshaler API expansion; proposal closed after head-repository deletion, not merger. Unsupported behavior alone is not a bug or reason for a duplicate PR.
SDK v7.26.8 requires x-reqid/x-log or returns ErrMaliciousResponse. Plain 200/JSON is not SDK success.
Stat/Copy/Delete use Background without a context argument; List forwarding or invented WithContext cannot fix them.
Real SDK/local HTTP: upload-child cancellation aborts leaked Writers without partial commit/caller cancellation. Success controls pass; not live GCS.
Rejected Qiniu/Dragonfly responses hide bodies. Local HTTP requires rejected-only Close; successful 200/206 remain caller-owned. Not cloud/reuse proof.
Rejected session hooks do not revoke admitted requests. Native revocation controls are not full restart qualification.
Recovery reacquires the initial archive snapshot; newly appearing archives invalidate it. Deliberate freshness, not forgotten arguments.
handle_async_request shields _response_closed on BaseException; the iterator closes at L579-585. StreamReset-only excerpts omit owning cleanup.
Native RST_STREAM rejection then same-connection success lies beyond line100. Not universal semaphore/cancellation proof.
torchrun initializes rank before the helpers. Import-only/120-line excerpts miss this; no distributed-execution claim.
get_supported_act_dtypes is an abstract instance method regardless of receiver spelling.
The loader calls quant_config's instance; class-only TypeError is not this caller's regression.
forward_extend retains forward_batch during identity checks; omitting it fabricates id reuse. Static, not NPU evidence.
Windows requires nonzero dev/ino, so self-comparison can fail; retained identity is checked after rename. Not all-race proof.
migrated spreads before combined notices. Empty collected notices preserve prior fields; the conditional alone is misleading.
Outer catch records JSON.parse failures and returns error. Earlier windows omit it; source evidence, not native coverage.
resolve matches shape then validates capacity. Shape-only supports cannot replace capacity checks or prove hardware support.
Support-query OR documented fallback with validated profiles is permitted, not an invented API mandate or backend proof.
SDK cancellation leaves ListAll retry alive. Native/race cancel/backoff/503 controls cover draining receivers, not blocked consumers/all backends.
Closed/unmerged prior work covers retry cancellation, token recovery/backoff. No novelty or broader-patch qualification from the narrow test.
The 2026.8.1 exception admits lifecycle, not final validation. Recollecting errors after their cause is cleared is not resurrection.
Completion promotes legacy state, runs pre/postinstall, then rejects pending markers. Nine native interruption/retry cases, not published-package/full-CLI proof.
Preinstall removes the guard only after Node validation. A fixture retaining it cannot assume success; trace removal, not waive final inventory errors.

SetUID/SetGID and FileInfo.Sys lock the same embedded FileData mutex. Missing outer MemMapFs.Chown locking is not unsynchronized UID/GID access. Separate setter locks do not promise an atomic pair; static evidence, not all-race proof.
